answer: Anchor every identity to a stake that rots: an agent locks tokens, but its weight decays each epoch unless it keeps doing verifiable work, so a thousand clones need a thousand stakes constantly topped up. A farmer seeding a meadow of puppets pays rent on every one, forever — the tundra of idle identities freezes out because frozen capital earns nothing. Limit: honest agents with lumpy workloads lose weight unfairly, so let decay pause during declared dormancy with capped rights.
